what: At the bottom of the panel, fourteen white toy shapes (ring·two balls·star·rounded square frame·triangle frame·arc shape, two sets) bounce up as Matter bodies and lie piled, and every 200px the mouse moves over the panel, one more of the same type drops 200px to the right of that spot and bounces (gravity .0005 · restitution .8 · air friction .0001 · friction .01). Past 20, any one is removed. Sizes are in cells of the panel width, 110 cells (50 cells at 1023px and below) — ring radius 8 cells, balls 4·3, star 4, square frame 10, triangle frame radius 10, arc 5.7×14 cells. On touch screens, one drops at each press spot

options.every: Mouse travel distance (px) that drops one shape, default 200
options.offset: Horizontal drift of the landing spot (px), default 200 (as in the original)
options.cols · cols-narrow · narrow: Cell count 110 · narrow screen 50 · narrow screen width 1023
options.--fx-h: Canvas height, default 100vh (sticks to the bottom edge of the board)
options.canvas[data-fx-part=canvas]: Canvas to draw on (optional) — the part creates one if missing

note: For the first 5 seconds the shapes are spun and settled to the floor even when the board is not visible (the original runs from the moment the page opens). After that it spins and draws only while the board is visible. In the original triangle the body (pointing left) and the artwork (pointing up) are out of line, so the body is stood up to point up like the artwork. The original attached a shape image file (white PNG), and here the same shapes are drawn through a canvas path. With reduced motion, only one pre-settled frame is drawn.

from.where: shared.js footer .pk-footer — original script.js koalaMatter: vw(t)=(_w/110 · /50 when narrow)×t, gravity.scale 5e-4, restitution .8 · frictionAir 1e-4 · friction .01, handleMouseMove calls cloneBody(i+200, n) every 200px and removes a random body past 20, floor _h+26(50) · side walls 50×2_h, matter-js 0.20.0 (matter-wrap 0.1.3 is only registered, never used)
